d: This work re-examines Yugi’s "strength" from a different perspective—exploring why Yugi chose to send the Pharaoh to the Netherworld rather than fighting at all costs to keep him alive as a beloved companion. Hari delves into whether that resolute strength might actually double as a form of emotional vulnerability, while playfully crafting an alternate "survival route" where Yugi takes matters into his own hands. The afterword also notes a crucial detail in the story: in the scene where Yugi breaks down in tears after handing over past memories, the Pharaoh has secretly inherited those memories, subtly affirming their enduring emotional bond.
